title: Viva Glint: survey-taking refinements to comment auto-save, a single Next button and auto-scroll
summary: Hold: the Optional question guidance omits Microsoft's restriction of the cited documentation to Engagement survey programs, leaving 360 survey owners with an inapplicable route. The roadmap facts and subscription requirements are supported; the comment-expansion path needs only a missing section heading.

claims.claim: The comment-expansion control is at Configuration > Surveys > Survey programs > program > Program Setup > Auto-expand comments input in the Viva Glint admin dashboard.
claims.quote: The Program Setup page is the first section in Program Summary for a Microsoft Viva Glint survey. In the first section on the Program setup page, define, enable, or disable each field: Auto-expand comments input.
claims.fix: Insert the omitted Program Summary heading: 'Configuration > Surveys > Survey programs > program > Program Summary > Program Setup > Auto-expand comments input'. Questions setup, already cited, supplies Configuration > Surveys > Survey programs and selection of the survey; the cited Program Setup page supplies the control.

claims.claim: Auto-expand comments input applies to rating items only.
